Tips_en: A shard condensed from the first light of dawn, still warm in the palm.
Description_en: At combat start, gain 1 stack of {SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance}. The first time a round starts each combat, if you have {SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance}, gain 3 Shield.

Tips_en: A lining as thin as morning mist, folding flame back into light.
Description_en: At round start, if you have {buff_burn}, remove 1 stack of {buff_burn} and gain 1 stack of {SunExp_sunexp_gathered_flame}. Triggers once per round.

Tips_en: There is no reflection in the mirror, only a sun in perpetual orbit.
Description_en: Every 3 actions, if you have {SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance}, apply 1 stack of {buff_burn} to a random enemy; otherwise gain 1 stack of {SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance}.

Tips_en: Its inner wall is etched with reverse-flowing tongues of fire, built to collect runaway heat.
Description_en: At round start, remove 1 stack of {buff_burn} from a random enemy that has it and gain 1 stack of {SunExp_sunexp_gathered_flame}. If no enemy has {buff_burn}, apply 1 stack of {buff_burn} to a random enemy instead.

Tips_en: Each notch on the dial marks a shift in the sun angle.
Description_en: Each combat, the first time {SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance} reaches 4/8/12 stacks, respectively: draw 1 card, gain 1 Mana, clear your {buff_burn}.

Tips_en: What shields the city is not glass, but noon held in place.
Description_en: At round start, if you have {SunExp_sunexp_solar_field}, gain Shield equal to its stacks x2. Then, if you do not have {buff_burn}, gain 1 stack of {SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance}.

Tips_en: Less a relic than a small sun forced to remain quiet.
Description_en: At combat start, gain 1 stack of {SunExp_sunexp_solar_crown_state}, 2 stacks of {SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance}, and 1 stack of {SunExp_sunexp_solar_field}. {SunExp_sunexp_solar_field} applies {buff_burn} to all combatants at round start; {SunExp_sunexp_burn_ward} or the highest Crown phase can prevent your self-burn from it.
